lessons.title: Sangam literature foundations
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of sangam literature foundations and apply it accurately to unfamiliar challenges.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Classical literature study requires attention to text, genre, historical context and interpretation. Sangam works, epics and ethical traditions should be studied through identifiable themes and textual evidence rather than vague cultural claims. Comparative interpretation needs an explicit basis. Focus specifically on sangam literature foundations. Identify the core concepts, common misconceptions, evidence or procedure required, and the verification step that protects against error. Move from recognition to application: identify what the task tests, choose an appropriate method, execute it carefully, and check the result against the original requirements. Keep an error log that describes the underlying reasoning failure.
examples: A Indian Classical Literature & Wisdom Championship task on sangam literature foundations should begin by identifying the defining clue or requirement before selecting the method.
Create a new sangam literature foundations scenario with one plausible distractor and explain why the preferred answer or solution satisfies the requirements.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused Indian Classical Literature & Wisdom Championship activity on sangam literature foundations using a worked problem, diagram, table, passage, code trace or comparison as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on sangam literature foundations: model the first, prompt the second, and require an independent solution to the third with explicit justification.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar sangam literature foundations questions or tasks without viewing solutions.
Create and complete one new challenge using the lesson principle.
Analyse one error and write the rule or strategy that would prevent it next time.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item Indian Classical Literature & Wisdom Championship checkpoint on sangam literature foundations; target at least six correct and justify uncertain responses.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished Indian Classical Literature & Wisdom Championship task demonstrating sangam literature foundations and document the reasoning, evidence or performance criteria used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise terminology, evidence and independent verification. Ask learners to explain the method before confirming the answer. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one measurable action for improving sangam literature foundations.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Challenge → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
